subtitle: Official Android Application for Staff & Field Operations
changelog: v1.0.7: Official release with Push & In-App Notification Pipeline, FCM HTTP v1 Migration & RLS Security Fixes
Migrated FCM backend push delivery from deprecated legacy API to Google FCM HTTP v1 API
Fixed user_devices FCM token upsert table constraints for persistent device registration
Fixed notification_type casing mismatch (UPPER_CASE) for correct deep-link navigation
Added web platform guards (kIsWeb) for Firebase and Platform.isAndroid
